text: Redmond Rovers have established clear territorial dominance through their 4-3-3 high press system, achieving a 71.2% possession rate, 79.2% pass accuracy, and an overwhelming 95.8% field tilt in the last 10 minutes, with a PPDA of 2.5 indicating intense pressing triggers high up the pitch. Their mechanism relies on quick ball circulation and high defensive line to force Ironvale Athletic into a low block 5-3-2 formation with only a 4.2% field tilt, effectively rest-defending to absorb pressure and limit progression. Despite 10 final third entries and sustained overloads, Redmond generated just one low-xG shot (0.06) that was blocked, highlighting a preference for controlled build-up transitions over risky direct attempts. Ironvale’s counter-attacking threat under deep defensive block yielded their sole shot with xG 0.58, but Redmond’s pressing patterns thus far have suppressed further exploiting opportunities.
